ignoreValues.reason: Pixel sampler crossing a control's edge, not a real ratio. /app's primary buttons are stock on ink (about 13:1) and its secondary text is 9.1:1; the detector reads the rendered image, so a sample that straddles a dark button's anti-aliased boundary on a stock-sunk panel returns 3.2-4.4:1 and the reported colours are always blends that appear in no stylesheet (#5e635f on #bcbbb0 = ink at 59% over ink at 22% over stock-sunk). axe-core runs the WCAG colour-contrast rule against the DOM on this page in qa/a11y.spec.ts and reports it clean, and qa/a11y.spec.ts also asserts the busy state cannot be shown with opacity.
